page.overview:
Who is Razina Hazzan?

Razina is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was taken prisoner during the Battle of Dumai's Wells by the Asha'man.
